p: five men: That the king might be assured that they had come, and to see what type of people they were.
land of Egypt is before thee: Joseph's great modesty appears in that he would attempt nothing without the king's commandment.
Rameses: Which was a city in the country of Goshen, Ex 1:11.
according to their families: Some read that he fed them as little babies, because they could not provide for themselves against that famine.
Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's: In which he both declares his faithfulness to the king, and his freedom from covetousness.
land: For unless the ground is tilled and sown, it perishes and is as if it was dead.
removed them to cities from one: By this changing they signified that they had nothing of their own, but received everything from the king's generosity.
except the land of the priests: Pharaoh, in providing for idolatrous priests, will be a condemnation to all those who neglect the true ministers of God's word.
lie with my fathers: By this he demonstrated that he died in the faith of his fathers, teaching his children to hope for the promised land.
bowed himself upon the bed's head: He rejoiced that Joseph had promised him, and setting himself up on his pillows, praised God; 1Ch 29:10.
